en: To come underneath (something).
To be included or classified under (a title, specified class etc.).

en: From another point of view; on the other hand; on second thought; again.

en: To make (something) last for more time than is necessary; to prolong; to extend.

en: behind the scenery and stage area; backstage; among the actors; during the production or rehearsal
